venue: Colin Cloud: Mastermind at Harrah's Las Vegas

zones.label: Section A
zones.description: Section A is the nearest band to the stage. Choose it for the closest view of the performer.

zones.label: Section B
zones.description: Section B sits just behind A, with center and side blocks. It keeps you close to the stage while giving you a little more room to take in the full setup.

zones.label: Section C
zones.description: Section C is the third band from the stage. Its center and side blocks give you a wider view of the stage while keeping you within the main seating area.

zones.label: Section D · Center
zones.description: The center block of Section D faces the stage from the back of the chart. It is our pick if you prefer a little more distance with a centered view.

zones.label: Section D · Sides
zones.description: The outer Section D blocks sit at the back on either side. They offer a wider, angled view of the stage.
